contexts.text: On a sphere of adultery. - While (people) are speaking against the truths and goods of faith and charity, there is produced a sphere that is meretricious and of adultery, and then adulterers gather there, like ravens to a carcase, and are delighted with the stench that prevails there...

When the Angels are discoursing about the union of good and truth, then, in a lower region... with evil Spirits, there is presented a representative of adultery. Hence it is that the adulteration of good, the falsification of truth, are called adultery and whoredom.
